title: Ancient Sanctuary - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Ancient Sanctuary in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A maze-like sanctuary holding the Robust and Catapult Sakapatate enemies. It is the source of Sakaram and one of the better early farming spots.

sections.title: How to Reach Ancient Sanctuary
sections.content: Entered from The Continent during Act 1. The Sanctuary Maze Flag splits into a fork; the weapon is down the left path.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Ultimate Sakapatate, Robust Sakapatate, Catapult Sakapatate, Ranger Sakapatate
